<!-- What changes, and why. For a signing change, which request was signed wrongly or rejected and how you checked it against botocore or the AWS SDK. -->

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (tests, types, package checks, lint and format).
- [ ] A bug fix has a case that fails before the fix (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] A change users will notice has a `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `Unreleased`.
- [ ] A change to `src/` that could affect speed, memory or size says so, with the measurement (`bench/`).
- [ ] Nothing names a private project or repository, a local path, a home directory or a credential.
